scope: Content fitting across the original and modern LING285 studio, both modules, collections and readers.
preservation: Existing course payloads, source assets, transcript editions, question IDs and saved responses remain unchanged.
fixes: Natural-height source galleries keep every slide and caption in document flow.
Card and reader bodies own consistent inner spacing; nested pairs do not cancel it.
Desktop workspace pairs retain text on the left and source visuals on the right; the broad 1450px stacking rule has been removed.
Playback controls occupy a separate row below each video instead of covering its content.
Workspace cards retain their full-width study footers; readers keep notes and read controls in their independently scrollable transcript panel.
Long code, tables and selected option descriptions fit without hiding their contents.

otherChecks: Every numbered collection at desktop/mobile widths
Actual source-media aspect ratios after loading
Current 100-question test, eight lecture quizzes, writing drafts and backup workflow

appliesTo: Expanded readers from every workspace section
readerPanels.referenceStructure: PSYC301 controls plus transcript and visual cards, with the corresponding LING406 reader structure inspected.
readerPanels.desktop: Two equal columns with transcript left and original slide/video right.
readerPanels.scrolling: Separate overflow and scroll containment, including real wheel checks at both boundaries.
readerPanels.mobile: PSYC/LING406-style narrow-screen adaptation with individually scrollable panels; no source cropping.
readerPanels.controls: Previous/selected page/next remain above both panels; source-page positions survive expansion and return.
